answers.answer: The Ready column shows an error message with a Retry button (cards not loaded); the count line under the filters shows only the loaded cards from the other columns (excluding Ready), e.g. a total that omits Ready's cards.

The board with all five columns loaded and cards shown; 2 board loads were requested in all; focus is on the board heading/main content area (the region that replaced the error), not on the Try again button which is gone.
The window title shows the card's title/ID for SL-102 (e.g. 'SL-102 · Slate'); 2 card loads were requested.
The address is still #/ (the filter is debounced and not yet applied); Backlog still shows all its cards unfiltered.
The address becomes #/?q=login%20fix; the history did not grow (replaced, not pushed); Backlog and Ready show only cards matching 'login fix' (e.g. Backlog SL-102, Ready SL-111).
Focus is on card SL-125 (the matching card) on the board, after the filter applies immediately on Enter.

The address is normalized to #/?labels=bug,perf&q=search%20results (unknown label dropped, sorted, whitespace collapsed); history did not grow (replaced); cards shown are those with both bug and perf labels matching 'search results'.
Focus stays on SL-119 (ArrowRight does nothing without move mode).
Focus moves to the next focusable element after the board's card list (card roving tabindex leaves the board), e.g. the bulk toolbar/next control after the board, not another card.
The address is #/?q=sl-125; focus is on the board/card (first Escape leaves the field to the board, second does nothing more), e.g. on the card SL-125.
0 cards selected (x selects SL-111; Shift+X selects all Ready; Shift+X again deselects all of the column).
In progress contains SL-101, SL-102, SL-103 plus its existing cards (appended at the end); the notice says 'Moved 3 cards to In progress' with an Undo; the 3 moved cards stay selected.

Notice says 'Moved 2 of 3 cards to Review. 1 failed' (with Retry); SL-107 stays selected only; Backlog has SL-107 still in its original place without SL-106 and SL-108, and Review has SL-106 and SL-108 appended at the end.
0 cards are selected? No: 7 stay selected—selection persists through filters; after Clear filters, 7 cards are selected.
SL-119 is in Review; the notice says 'Moved SL-119 to Review' with Undo.
SL-116 is in In progress; the notice says 'Moved SL-116 to In progress'; 2 move requests were sent in all.
Ready order is unchanged with SL-101 inserted? The drop lands after SL-113 / before the item under the pointer; notice says 'Moved SL-101 to Ready'.
Backlog first four cards in original order with SL-111 inserted at the position after SL-102 (second position): SL-101, SL-102, SL-111, SL-103.
SL-107 is back in its original column (Backlog) after rollback; focus returns to card SL-107; the notice says 'Couldn't move SL-107' with a Retry button.
SL-107 is in Ready (the retry succeeds); the notice says 'Moved SL-107 to Ready'.
SL-108 stays in the column it was moved to (undo failed, rolled forward); the notice says 'Couldn't undo move of SL-108'.
Focus moves to the previous card SL-109; no delete request is sent yet (a delayed delete with Undo notice).
No delete request has been sent yet; the notice is still shown.
Yes, the delete request has been sent; the notice is dismissed.
SL-105 is back in its original place in its column; focus is on SL-105; no delete request was sent.
1 delete request has been sent (SL-103 is committed when a new delete starts); the notice says SL-105 deleted with Undo.
SL-125 is restored to its original place in its column; the notice says 'Couldn't delete SL-125' with a Retry.
Yes, the failure notice is still shown (error notices persist until dismissed).
SL-101 is still in the column it was moved to (Ctrl+Z in a text field is not intercepted); 1 move request was sent; the notice is still shown.
An error message 'Title must be 80 characters or fewer' is shown; focus stays in the Title field; no save was sent.
Yes, the title is accepted; focus returns to the 'Edit title' button; a save was sent.
The original title is shown (blank rejected); a message 'Title is required' is shown; no save was sent.
Only the labels not yet applied can be added (all other labels besides bug, ui, perf are pressable); a note says the card already has the maximum of 3 labels.
The new comment shows 'First note' (trimmed) in a pending/sending state; the comment field is disabled so the user cannot type.
The address is #/card/SL-114 still? Escape with unsaved draft does not close; address stays #/card/SL-114, focus in the comment field, no comment sent.
The comments for SL-120 are listed (loaded successfully).
The address returns to #/?labels=bug; history gained one entry on open, and Escape goes back (history back); focus returns to card SL-114.
The card detail SL-114 is shown again; history moves back/forward by one entry; 2 card loads were requested.
A 'Card not found' page; the window title is 'Card not found · Slate'; no card load was requested.

ambiguities: PRB-019: whether selection persists when filtering hides selected cards
PRB-047: whether Escape closes the card with an unsent draft
PRB-023: drop position relative to the card under the pointer
